reproduction.rationale: Reproduction is a separate first-class outcome within this single original task. Both information conditions must share the complete14-session original scientific identities, observations, fixed3b selection, all224 native output fields and full finding/companion vector; author code is the only permitted information addition. Native A/B source interfaces exist, but authenticated common input/cohort/qid/panel manifests, protected exposures, exact selected author-code delivery, cumulative budgets, independent analysis execution and granular output-verification identities are not qualified. Source-code pins and published scores cannot fill these absent protocol fields. The five-fold purged extension and equal-person nativeMAE cannot silently replace original Figure3 outcomes.
